Odysseus.style: Odysseus, a hardened Greek captain in his forties, low and commanding, trying to keep his men calm

Eurylochus.style: Eurylochus, a gruff veteran sailor with a gravelly voice

Polites.style: Polites, a young sailor barely twenty, nervous and earnest

Perimedes.style: Perimedes, a wiry sailor with a breathy voice

Polyphemus.style: Polyphemus, an enormous one-eyed giant with a slow, cavernous, rumbling voice

lines.direction: whispered, frozen with dread, as the footsteps of something huge approach
a loud, sharp shouted command to his men across the cave, full of alarm. Absolutely not whispering.

lines.text: The entrance... <gasp> he's sealed it with a rock.
lines.direction: horror dawning, breath catching, voice starting to shake

lines.text: <gasp> He's COMING!! AIM FOR THE EYE!!
lines.direction: SCREAMING at full volume to warn the others across a huge cave, panicked, voice cracking. Absolutely not whispering.

lines.text: No, no, no... he's waking up!
lines.direction: rising panic, frantic whisper that breaks into a cry
yelling at the top of his lungs in sheer terror, out of breath from sprinting. Absolutely not whispering.

lines.text: Father Poseidon... <long pause> they blinded me...
lines.direction: agonized, sobbing with rage, a wounded monster
